name: Bang Motion (Browser Motion Graphics & Video)
description: GSAP & Three.js kinetic video, openers & motion graphics with official starters & sync
ai_instructions:
Follow the official Bang Motion workflow (bangtutorial/bang-motion):

1. WORKFLOW (6 PHASES):
   • Phase 1 (Brief): Identify product/topic, brand colors/logo, audio/VO, duration (25-40s for opener, 30-90s for explainer), and aspect ratio (16:9 for Web/YouTube or 9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts).
   • Phase 2 (Style Brief — Three Candidates, One Pick): DO NOT write code yet. Inspect project context (README.md, package.json, tech stack, domain) and propose 3 specific concept candidates with:
     - Concept: Pick from the 19 Opener Concepts or 6 Explainer Styles.
     - Style Direction: Pick from the 10 Style Directions.
     - Palette with Source: 1 primary brand HEX, 1 background HEX, 1 accent HEX (explicitly stating source).
     - Rationale: Explain why each candidate fits the product.
   • Phase 3 (User Approval): Wait for the user to confirm 1 candidate or adjust parameters.
   • Phase 4 (Build from Official Starter): Adapt the corresponding starter template from `rigtools/bang_motion/assets/` (or GSAP v3 + Three.js from CDN) into a single self-contained `rigmotion/index.html`.
   • Phase 5 (Anti-PowerPoint Motion Rules):
     - No static slide deck fades (scenes must change via continuous camera traveling, whip pan, or push-through, not fading `<section>`).
     - Persistent subject or shared world across transitions.
     - Max 2 text levels per scene (min 30px font on 1080p).
     - Deterministic timeline: all animations strictly driven by `tl.time()` (no Date.now() / Math.random()).
   • Phase 6 (Controls & Video Export):
     - Include autoplay, loop, and `?debug=1` timeline scrubbing parameter.
     - One-Click Video Download: Floating '🎥 Download Video' button using browser MediaRecorder API with tab capture or canvas.captureStream(60) to export .webm/.mp4.
     - Studio MP4 export command: `ffmpeg -framerate 60 -i frames/f%05d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 16 output.mp4`.

2. 10 STYLE DIRECTIONS:
   1. Cinematic dark (near-black, bloom on objects, bold grotesk | creative tools, gaming, tech)
   2. Poster color-block (solid color fields, giant cropped letters | consumer apps, music, events)
   3. Editorial light (white/cream, display serif + hairlines | productivity, finance, SaaS)
   4. Paper & print (paper texture, collage, stamps, handwriting | education, community, food)
   5. Retro / analog (faded color, grain, scanlines, geometric | nostalgia, entertainment)
   6. Brutalist mono (B&W hard grid, monospace, hard cuts | developer tools, CLI)
   7. Pastel playful (stacked pastels, rounded shapes, elastic bounce | kids, health, lifestyle)
   8. Luxury dark (black + gold/bronze, tall wide-tracked serif | fashion, automotive, luxury)
   9. Flat pop with photos (stickers, photo cutouts, snapping on beat | fintech, consumer, e-commerce)
   10. Grainy gradient (deep base, glowing shapes, fine grain, traveling camera | AI, tech, launches)

3. 19 OPENER CONCEPTS:
   1. One continuous shot 2. Pure typography 3. Problem -> gone 4. Before / after 5. Journey inside the UI 6. Product macro 7. Object metaphor 8. Living number 9. One feature fully demoed 10. Diegetic question -> answer 11. Rhythmic collage 12. Logo as stage 13. Object relay 14. Brand system showcase 15. Claim -> how -> result 16. Living UI ecosystem 17. Flat pop with photos 18. Through the gradient shapes 19. Product tour with claims.

4. 6 EXPLAINER STYLES & STARTERS (in `rigtools/bang_motion/assets/`):
   1. Continuous action (`starter-explainer.html`)
   2. Cartoon collage (`starter-explainer-kartun.html`)
   3. Visual journalism (`starter-explainer-jurnalisme.html`)
   4. White catalog (`starter-explainer-katalog.html`)
   5. Vintage sketch (`starter-explainer-sketsa.html`)
   6. Cartoon stage (`starter-explainer-panggung.html`)

claude_command.name: bang-motion
claude_command.content:
# /bang-motion <brief> [aspect_ratio] [concept/style]

Generate browser-based motion graphics or kinetic video using the official Bang Motion workflow:

1. **Style Brief (Three Candidates, One Pick):** If concept/style is not specified, DO NOT write code yet. Inspect project context (README.md, package.json, tech stack, domain) and present 3 Concept Candidates:
   - Propose 3 combinations of Concept (from 19 opener concepts / 6 explainer styles) and Style Direction (from 10 style directions).
   - Provide a 3-color palette (Primary Brand HEX, Background HEX, Accent HEX) extracted from project assets.
   - Give concise rationale why each candidate fits this project.
   - Ask user to confirm 1 candidate and aspect ratio (16:9 vs 9:16).
2. **Official Starters:** Adapt the corresponding starter template from `rigtools/bang_motion/assets/` (e.g. `starter-opener.html` or `starter-explainer-*.html`) and build into a self-contained `rigmotion/index.html`.
3. **Anti-PowerPoint Rules:** Continuous moving camera with depth (push-through / whip pan), persistent subject, max 2 text levels per scene (min 30px at 1080p), zero static slide deck fades.
4. **Controls & Export:** Include `?debug=1` scrubber, in-browser '🎥 Download Video' button (MediaRecorder), and ffmpeg lossless 60fps frame-export command.
